template_data.headline_html: Four moves that get you to the table early.

items.title: Track Sources Sought
items.sub: They surface 6–18 months before RFQs — comment on them and get on the CO's radar first

items.title: Own 2 agencies, not 20
items.sub: VA+DoD+DHS+USDA awarded $22B to small businesses Q2 2026. Source · USAspending.gov

items.title: Map recompetes in FPDS-NG
items.sub: Most contracts re-compete. Find the incumbent. Study their scope before the RFQ drops

items.title: Register in agency portals now
items.sub: PIEE for DoD, agency systems for others — some COs only look at vendors already in their registry

items.title: Show up to industry days
items.sub: Free intel on upcoming scope, CO introductions, and a chance to get on a prime's teaming radar
